   764|    fun toggleMeal(kidId: String, mealId: String) {
   765|        val today = LocalDate.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE)
   766|        _meals.update { current ->
   767|            val list = current[kidId].orEmpty().map { meal ->
   768|                if (meal.id == mealId) meal.copy(eaten = !meal.eaten) else meal
   769|            }
   770|            current + (kidId to list)
   771|        }
   772|        // Update streak
   773|        _streaks.update { s ->
   774|            val prev = s[kidId] ?: StreakInfo()
   775|            val currentStreak = if (prev.lastLogDate == today) prev.currentStreak
   776|            else if (prev.lastLogDate == LocalDate.now().minusDays(1).format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE))
   777|                prev.currentStreak + 1
   778|            else 1
   779|            s + (kidId to StreakInfo(
   780|                currentStreak = currentStreak,
   781|                bestStreak = maxOf(prev.bestStreak, currentStreak),
   782|                lastLogDate = today,
   783|            ))
   784|        }
   785|        persistState()
   786|        syncMealsToSupabase(kidId)
   787|        syncStreakToSupabase(kidId)
   788|    }

   975|    private fun computeScore(growth: List<GrowthPoint>): Int {
   976|        if (growth.size < 2) return 80
   977|        val last = growth.last()
   978|        val prev = growth[growth.size - 2]
   979|        val heightGain = last.height - prev.height
   980|        val weightGain = last.weight - prev.weight
   981|        val score = when {
   982|            heightGain > 1f && weightGain in 0.3f..1.5f -> 92
   983|            heightGain > 0.5f -> 85
   984|            heightGain > 0f -> 78
   985|            else -> 70
   986|        }
   987|        return score.coerceIn(0, 100)
   988|    }

| 18 | Deep link unhandled | `handleDeepLink()` in `MainActivity` + `onNewIntent` for `vitahero://auth` callbacks |
| 20 | Hardcoded UI strings | Added 16 new locale keys with Hindi/Telugu translations. Updated AuthScreen and OtpScreen to use `t(S.key)` everywhere |

### Remaining (lower priority, didn't block build)
- **#8-#12**: Food recognition, AI coach, leaderboard, family sharing, wearable — functional stubs that work for demo but need real API wiring
- **#17**: Zero tests
- **#19**: Crash reporting / analytics

Want me to tackle any of the remaining items?
